sn46.56:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
sn46.56:1.3: atha kho abhayo rājakumāro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho abhayo rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.56:1.5: natthi hetu natthi paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya
sn46.56:1.7: natthi hetu natthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya
sn46.56:1.10: atthi rājakumāra hetu atthi paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya
sn46.56:1.12: atthi rājakumāra hetu atthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya
sn46.56:2.1: katamo bhante hetu katamo paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
sn46.56:2.2: kathaṃ sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hotīti.
sn46.56:2.3: yasmiṃ kho rājakumāra samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti na passati.
sn46.56:2.4: ayampi kho rājakumāra hetu ayaṃ paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
sn46.56:2.5: evampi sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hoti.
sn46.56:3.1: puna caparaṃ rājakumāra yasmiṃ samaye byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti na passati. ayampi kho rājakumāra hetu ayaṃ paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya. evampi sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hoti. puna caparaṃ rājakumāra yasmiṃ samaye
sn46.56:3.4: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti na passati.
sn46.56:3.5: ayampi kho rājakumāra hetu ayaṃ paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
sn46.56:3.6: evampi sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hotīti.
sn46.56:4.5: ekamekenapi kho bhante nīvaraṇena abhibhūto yathābhūtaṃ nappajāneyya na passeyya ko pana vādo pañcahi nīvaraṇehi.
sn46.56:5.1: katamo pana bhante hetu katamo paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
sn46.56:5.2: kathaṃ sahetu sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
sn46.56:5.3: idha rājakumāra bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.56:5.4: so satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti tena cittena yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti passati.
sn46.56:5.5: ayampi kho rājakumāra hetu ayaṃ paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
sn46.56:5.6: evampi sahetu sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hoti.
sn46.56:6.2: upekkhāsambajjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.56:6.3: so upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti tena cittena yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti passati.
sn46.56:6.4: ayaṃpi kho rājakumāra hetu ayaṃ paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
sn46.56:6.5: evampi sahetu sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
sn46.56:7.5: ekamekenapi kho bhante bojjhaṅgena samannāgato yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyya passeyya ko pana vādo sattahi bojjhaṅgehi.
sn46.56:7.6: yopi me bhante gijjhakūṭaṃ pabbataṃ ārohantassa kāyakilamatho cittakilamatho sopi me paṭippassaddho dhammo ca me abhisametoti.
